# ffxf_database_detach (Resource)

Detaches a fork from its parent as a one-shot operation. The database is unavailable for about 30 seconds; backups begin afterward. This operation cannot be reversed. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_database_detach" "example" {
  database_id = 43
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) ID of the linked fork to detach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID for the detach operation.
